proofs.text: Read the observations out of `It looks fine to me.`, `not available` and an empty answer; verify each observes nothing and leaves the question not answered

rule_text: An answer in no shape the brief can read observes nothing and leaves the question not answered

tests.body:
def test_an_answer_in_no_shape_at_all_observes_nothing(self):
        assert brief_module.model_observations('It looks fine to me.') == (
            [], None)
        assert brief_module.model_observations('not available') == ([], None)
        assert brief_module.model_observations('') == ([], None)
tests.name: test_an_answer_in_no_shape_at_all_observes_nothing
